title: Six Days to the 57th GST Council
subtitle: A labelled composite electronics CFO must decide how to treat inverted-duty cash, a possible mobile-handset rate cut, and zero-mismatch ITC blocks before the Council meets in New Delhi on 12 September 2026
description: HBS-style teaching case dated 6 September 2026. Publicly reported facts: the GST Council Secretariat scheduled the 57th meeting for 12 September 2026 in New Delhi after a 374-day gap, with an officers' meeting on 11 September; inverted duty and a possible cut in GST on mobile handsets from 18 percent are on the public radar; from 1 April 2026 the GST portal enforces zero-mismatch between GSTR-2B and claimed ITC; ICAI released the 14th edition of Background Material on GST on 4 September 2026 covering Finance Act 2026 and GST 2.0. Composite firm: Meridian Devices India. Composite CFO: Kavya Rao.
thumbnail: COUNCIL IN SIX DAYS. CASH STILL STUCK.
sources: The Hindu Business Line, 30 August 2026. GST Council to meet 12 September after 374-day hiatus; inverted duty and mobile-handset rate cut on radar.
Angel One / Moneycontrol reporting of GST Council Secretariat memorandum. 57th GST Council, New Delhi, 12 September 2026, 11:00; officers' meeting 11 September.
Ranjeet Mahtani, Dhruva Advisors, quoted in Hindu Business Line. Accumulated compensation cess after levy discontinued estimated conservatively around Rs 6,000 crore.
Brijesh Kothary, Khaitan and Co, quoted in Hindu Business Line. GST 2.0 simplified slabs but deepened inverted tax; Budget 2026 provisional refunds do not cover input services.

BW Legal World, Sudipta Bhattacharjee, Khaitan and Co. From 1 April 2026 GST portal enforces zero-mismatch: GSTR-2B vs claimed ITC blocks return filing. Finance Act 2026 removed Section 13(8)(b) on intermediaries.
ICAI, 4 September 2026. 14th Edition of Background Material on GST updated for Finance Act 2026 and GST 2.0 through 30 June 2026. Two volumes.

GST Council 56th meeting, 3-4 September 2025. Rate structure effective 22 September 2025: 5% merit, 18% standard, 40% demerit. Government briefing on estimated annualised fiscal impact of about Rs 48,000 crore.
